units.title: Get the Telescope Ready and Find Jupiter
units.goal: Learner can set up the small telescope safely, align the finder, and use low power to put Jupiter in the eyepiece; this comes first because every later moon observation depends on reliable pointing.

objectives.title: Explain the safe setup steps and align the finder so a distant target stays centered
Use a sky chart or planetarium app to locate Jupiter and place it in a low-power eyepiece

units.title: Identify Jupiter's Moons and Record Their Positions
units.goal: Learner can use repeated low-power views to identify Jupiter's bright moons, sketch their positions, and explain why the pattern changes; it comes after Unit 1 because it reuses the same pointing and centering routine on a located Jupiter.
